title: SkillSourceUrl
description: A skill source's URL, as entered: https://, ssh:// or scp's [user@]host:path, naming a repository with an identity; no credential, query, fragment or leading hyphen, and no other scheme or local path. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule source-url and its reason; this pattern holds part of the rule, and cases/skill-source-url.json holds all of it.
